CONFIDENTIAL
DRAWER
No. 7864
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. 1. O.
Date. 14. 9. 32

MEMORANDUM ON THE MOVEMENTS OF A SUSPECTED JAVANESE
COMMUNIST KNOWN AS MOESO OR MUSO, ALIAS H.N. GAJATI,
ALIAS GAZALI, ALIAS CAJIES.

Moeso together with Alimin Prawirodirjo alias
Alinin alias Dirja, two leaders of the Communist Party
in the Netherlands East Indies were arrested in the
Straits Settlements on December 11, 1926 for communistic
activities and were released on March 19, 1927.

On March 26, 1927 they left the Straits Settlements
by the s.s. "Awa Maru" for Canton via Hongkong, with the
evident intention of proceeding to Shanghai and Hankow
where the advent of the Nationalist forces had already
taken place.

It is not definitely known whether either of the two
men did arrive in Shanghai en route to Hankow, but it was
established that they both attended the Pan Pacific Labour
Conference held in Hankow from May 20 to May 27, 1927.

On May 22, Moeso, who described himself as a
representative of the Javanese Labour Movement in
Indonesia addressed to Conference upon the prevailing
conditions in Indonesia. A joint report submitted by
Moeso and Alimin, who was selected as the Javanese member
of the Pan Pacific Trade Union Secretariat which was set
up in Hankow at that time, was considered by the assembly
on May 23.

Moeso left Hankow and arrived in Shanghai on July 21,
1927 under the pseudonym of H.N. Gajati alias Gazali, but
disappeared the same evening. It was however, ascertained
that he again returned to Shanghai from Hankow on August 25,
1927 by the s.s. "Talee Maru" and resided at 76 Range Road
until August 28, 1927 when he left for Vladivostok on the
Soviet steamer "Sishan." His object of this visit was
apparently to attend the Conference of the Peoples of the

关于一名被称为 MOESO 或 MUSO，化名 H.N. GAJATI，又化名 GAZALI，再化名 CAJIES 的疑似爪哇共产党人的行踪备忘录。

Moeso 与 Alimin Prawirodirjo（别名 Alinin，别名 Dirja）系荷属东印度群岛共产党的两名领导人，二人于1926年12月11日因从事共产主义活动在海峽殖民地被捕，并于1927年3月19日获释。

1927年3月26日，他们乘坐“阿波丸”号（Awa Maru）轮船离开海峡殖民地，经香港前往广州，其明显意图是前往国民党军队已经抵达的上海和汉口。

目前尚不确定这两人中是否有任何一人在前往汉口的途中抵达过上海，但已证实他们均参加了1927年5月20日至5月27日在汉口举行的泛太平洋劳工会议。

5月22日，自称印度尼西亚爪哇劳工运动代表的 Moeso 在会议上就印度尼西亚的当前局势发表了讲话。由 Moeso 和 Alimin 提交的联合报告于5月23日由大会审议，Alimin 当时被选为在汉口成立的泛太平洋工会书记处的爪哇成员。

Moeso 离开汉口，于1927年7月21日以 H.N. Gajati（别名 Gazali）的假名抵达上海，但当晚即失踪。然而，经查实，他于1927年8月25日再次乘坐“太利丸”号（Talee Maru）轮船从汉口返回上海，并居住在兰路（Range Road）76号，直至1927年8月28日乘坐苏联轮船“西山”号（Sishan）前往海参崴。他此次访问的目的显然是为了参加

Dear Mr. Akégi,

Many thanks for your letter of
September 15 conveying information regarding
three Japanese Communists of Chinese origin
named Oey Hwan Sien (黃懷信), Lie Kk-liep
(李益立) and Sick Dioen-jam (薛俊炎).
The information will prove a useful and interesting
addition to our files.

Yours sincerely,

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Mr. C. Akégi,
Secretary of Home Affairs Department,
Japanese Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

Javanese Communists of Chinese Origin.
f/ Oey Hwan Sien 黄 懷 德
Present Residence .....c/o Seiji Otomo 36/II Otsuka Nakamachi
Koishigawa-Ku.
Place of birth ..... Pekalongan, Java.
Above mentioned person, whose parents are both Chinese,
after finishing the primary school in the place of his birth
entered the First Normal School of Honan Province by the intro-
duction of his teacher. After staying in that school for two
years he left it and entered in June of 1927 the Chinese Art
School in Shanghai. But he again left that school after one
year study and started for Japan with Javanese passport. On 15th
of February he landed at Nagasaki; proceeded right away to Tokio
and put up at the First Chinese Dormitory, No.I Yanaka Mashima-
cho, Shitaya-Ku. There he entered the Foreign Language School,
Japanese Department, and removed to certain Abe, No 3491 Mukan-
hara, Sugamo-cho with his friend Lie Ek-liep, but again he left
there in July and removed to the present residence. Since Janu-
ary of this year he has studied German for three month, Russian
for a month and Italian for three months in the Summer Class of
that school. Besides he is now practising painting for himself.
His intention at present is, after studying French in "Athene
School", to go to France in order to study painting. And he is
going to drop in at his native place in December on his way to
Europe. 李 益 立
Lie Ek-liep, first year student of Imperial Art School.
Present Residence .....c/o S.Otomo 36/II Otsuka Nakamachi, Koi-
shigawa-Ku.
Place of birth .....Pekalongan, Java.
Above mentioned person, whose parents are both Chinese,
after graduating the primary school in the town of his birth,
by the introduction of his teacher entered the First Normal Scho-
ol of Honan Province with his friend Oey Hwan-sien. He left that
school two years after and entered, in June, 1927, the Shanghai
Art School, but again left it after a year and went over to Japan
with his friend Sick Dioen-jam(薛俊美). They landed at Kobe with
Dutch passport. At first they visited a Chinese student of High-
er Normal School at his house, No. 2, Miyanaka, Nishi-Sugamo-Cho,
and stayed for the time being at his house; but afterward the
fact that their friend was a member of Kuomintang caused the dif-
ference of opinion between them and consequently Lie Ek-liep left
his house and removed in May of last year to Abe's, No.3491 Muka-
uhara, Nishi-Sugamo-Cho with Oey Hwan-sien. Then he removed alone
to his present residence. He entered the To-a Preparatory School
on Dec.6th,1928. and left it after four months. He entered on April
3th,1929 Kawahata Art School, removed to Imperial Art School in
April of this year as a first year student, but again he is going
to get back to the former school from this September.
Sick Dioen-jam 薛 俊 美
Last Residence in Tokio ..... c/o S. Otomo,No.36/II Otsuka-Naka-

秘密

华裔爪哇共产党人。
f/ Oey Hwan Sien 黄 懷 德 [注：此处中文名与下文不同，下文为黄懷信，此处照录原文汉字]
现住址 ..... 转交 Seiji Otomo，小石川区大塚仲町 36/II 号。
出生地 ..... 爪哇，北加浪岸（Pekalongan）。
上述人士父母均为中国人，在出生地完成小学学业后，经老师介绍进入河南省立第一师范学校。在该校就读两年后离校，于1927年6月进入上海艺术专科学校。但学习一年后再次离校，持爪哇护照前往日本。2月15日在那霸 [注：原文为Nagasaki，长崎] 登陆；随即前往东京，寄宿在下谷区谷中真岛町1号的第一中华寮。随后进入该校外语科日语部，并与朋友 Lie Ek-liep 一同搬至巢鸭町无原3491号某 Abe 处，但7月再次离开该处，搬至现住址。自今年一月以来，他在该校暑期班学习了三个月德语、一个月俄语和三个月意大利语。此外，他现在正自行练习绘画。他目前的打算是在“雅典娜学校”（Athene School）学习法语后，前往法国学习绘画。他计划在前往欧洲的途中，于十二月顺道回故乡一趟。 李 益 立
Lie Ek-liep，帝国美术学校一年级学生。
现住址 ..... 转交 S.Otomo，小石川区大塚仲町 36/II 号。
出生地 ..... 爪哇，北加浪岸（Pekalongan）。
上述人士父母均为中国人，在出生城镇完成小学学业后，经老师介绍，与朋友 Oey Hwan-sien 一同进入河南省立第一师范学校。两年后离校，于1927年6月进入上海艺术专科学校，但一年后再次离校，与朋友 Sick Dioen-jam（薛俊美）一同前往日本。他们持荷兰护照在神户登陆。起初他们拜访了一位高等师范学校的中国学生，并在其位于西巢鸭町宫中2号的家中暂住；但后来因其朋友是国民党成员，导致双方意见不合，因此 Lie Ek-liep 离开其家，于去年五月与 Oey Hwan-sien 一同搬至西巢鸭町无原3491号 Abe 处。随后他独自搬至现住址。他于1928年12月6日进入东亚预备学校，四个月后离校。1929年4月3日进入川端画学校，今年四月作为一年级学生转入帝国美术学校，但从今年九月起他将再次回到之前的学校。
Sick Dioen-jam 薛 俊 美
在东京的最后住址 ..... 转交 S. Otomo，小石川区大塚仲町36/II 号。

no. 7864.

mashi, Koishigawa-Ku.
Place of Birth ..... Pekalongan, Java.
Above mentioned person, whose parents are both Chinese,
after graduating the primary school of his native town entered
the Honan Provincial Normal School with his two friends Oey
Hwar-sien and Lie Ek-liep. After two years study in the school
he removed to Chinang School in June of 1927, but he left that
school after a year and a half and went over to Japan, landing
with Dutch passport at Kobe on 17th of 1928. In Tokio he lived
with his friend Hakukan-Wun(伯陵雲), the student of Higher Nor-
mal School at his house, No.2446 Nakamaci, Nishi-Sugamo, and en-
tered To-a Yobi Gakko on Dec.6th of that year. About a half ye-
ar after he left that school and entered the Regular Music Sch-
ool. This time he left it after a month. He removed to Abe's,
No.3491 Mukau-hara, Nishi-Sugamocho with his two friends Oei
and Lie in May of 1929, but removed again to the above mention-
ed residence. Since then he was absorbed in reading the commu-
nistic books, but the money from his home being stopped he left
Japan for Shanghai in January of this year.
II/ According to what Oey Hwan-sien states Oey Hwan-siang
is holding no intention of coming over to Japan at present.
III/ Lie Ek-liep Sick Dioen-jam( November 1923) and Oey Hwar
sien(February 1929) associated in Tokio with Chinese communist-
ic students Chin So-jin(陳素人) O Bo-gen(王步根) Byo Teki-sei
(苗的青) and joined the Jinsha(人社), the coporation organ-
ized by these leftists. Towards the end of last year August
Lie and Sick, after discussing with O and Chin, the leading
people of that society passed the resolution to amalgamate in-
to Anti-Imperialistic League, and join the demonstration which
was held on Sept.4th at Ginza-Dori under the leadership of
Anti-Imperialistic League. At that time they escaped the hands
of Metropolitan Police. At present they are keeping close conn-
ection with the Chinese communists and joined the Tokio Branch
of Chinese Liberty League(中國自由大同盟) and working for the Commu-
nistic propaganda. Their activities are watched.
pages.zh:
编号 7864。
秘密

出生地 ..... 爪哇，北加浪岸（Pekalongan）。
上述人士父母均为中国人，在家乡完成小学学业后，与两位朋友 Oey Hwar-sien [原文拼写错误，应为Hwan Sien] 和 Lie Ek-liep 一同进入河南省立师范学校。在该校学习两年后，于1927年6月转入 Chinang [音译] 学校，但一年半后离校，持荷兰护照前往日本，于1928年[日期缺失]17日在神户登陆。在东京，他与朋友 Hakukan-Wun（伯陵雲）同住，后者是高等师范学校的学生，住在西巢鸭中町2446号，并于同年12月6日进入东亚预备学校（To-a Yobi Gakko）。约半年后离校，进入正规音乐学校。这次他一个月后离校。1929年5月，他与两位朋友 Oei 和 Lie 一同搬至西巢鸭町无原3491号 Abe 处，但随后又搬至上述住址。此后他沉迷于阅读共产主义书籍，但由于家中断绝汇款，他于今年一月离开日本前往上海。
II/ 据 Oey Hwan-sien 称，Oey Hwan-siang [原文如此] 目前无意前往日本。
III/ Lie Ek-liep、Sick Dioen-jam（1923年11月）和 Oey Hwar sien [原文拼写错误]（1929年2月）在东京与中国共产主义学生 Chin So-jin（陳素人）、O Bo-gen（王步根）、Byo Teki-sei（苗的青）交往，并加入了由这些左翼分子组织的社团“人社”（Jinsha）。去年八月下旬，Lie 和 Sick 与该社领导人 O 和 Chin 讨论后，通过决议并入反帝同盟，并参加由反帝同盟领导、于9月4日在银座通举行的示威活动。当时他们逃脱了警视厅的控制。目前他们与中国共产党人保持密切联系，加入了中国自由大同盟东京支部，并进行共产主义宣传。他们的活动受到监视。

I.O. 7864

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. 7864
Date 14 - 10 - 30

October 14, 30.

Dear Mr. Van den Berg,

With reference to your letter
of September 6, 1930, careful enquiries have
been made concerning the two Javanese Communists
named Semaoen and Soe Tjai Ko, but no trace
can be found of them in Shanghai. Efforts to
ascertain particulars of their movements will
be continued, and any information obtained will be
communicated to you in due course.

Yours sincerely,

J. Van den Berg Esq.,
Consulate-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

1930年10月14日。

亲爱的 Van den Berg 先生：

关于您1930年9月6日的来信，我们就名为 Semaoen 和 Soe Tjai Ko 的两名爪哇共产党人进行了仔细查询，但在上海未发现他们的踪迹。我们将继续努力查明他们的行踪细节，任何获得的情报将及时通报给您。

此致
敬礼，

J. Van den Berg 先生，
荷兰驻上海总领事馆。

CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.______
Special Branch No. 2 Station,
REPORT
Date October 13, 1930.
Subject (in full) Semaoen and Soe Tjai Ko, Javanese Communists.
Made by ______ and ______ Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan.

Sir,
With reference to attached letter dated September
6th 1930 from Mr. Van den Berg of the Netherlands
Consulate re: Semaoen and Soe Tjai Ko, Javanese Communists,
careful enquiries have failed to reveal their presence
in Shanghai. This matter has been brought to the attention
of the Javanese agent employed by S. I and enquiries are
being kept up. Should any information regarding their
movements be obtained, a report will be duly submitted.

W H Duncan.
D. S. I.

D. C.
(C. & S. Branches)

Reg. Please draft reply in
due course.
W H

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.

SHANGHAI. 6/7 '30

Dear Mr. Cecil.

According to a non-confidential
report from Rotterdam this
the well known Communist
Vermanen should be a patient of
Shanghai and visit every month
a masseur by name of Loe Tjai
Ko (Li Kun 立生?) 15/rev, so
called as a medicine salesman,
but in reality with the intention to
recruit touch with communists.

I must be much obliged
to be informed whether his Loe Tjai
Ko and his demands have been
noted here.

Yours faithfully yours
Clausen

(?) Do not remember having already informed
you of this bit of information prior
report. I join with you.
Supt. Robertson
(Sd) For careful investigation
and report JHS 8/9/30
pages.zh:
荷兰驻华中总领事馆。

上海。1930年7月6日

亲爱的 Cecil 先生：

根据来自鹿特丹的一份非机密报告，
著名的共产党人
Vermanen 应是上海的一名病人，并每月拜访
一位名为 Loe Tjai
Ko（Li Kun 立生？）的按摩师，15/rev [原文不清]，
此人自称药材商人，
但实际上意图
与共产党人建立联系。

若能告知此处是否已注意到
这位 Loe Tjai
Ko 及其要求，
我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼
Clausen

(?) 不记得在此前报告中
已告知您这一信息。我赞同您的看法。
督察长 Robertson

pages.en:
January 10, _B

Dear Sir,

With reference to your letter of January 6
regarding Tan Malaka, I have to inform you that the local
Chinese Authorities are not interested in the fact that
this man is at present in Amoy as that place is not within
their jurisdiction, and further, Amoy is under the Chinese
Naval Authorities of that port with whom the local
Authorities are not in communication.

Yours faithfully,

J. Van den Berg Esq.,
Junior Interpreter,
Netherlands Consulate-General.
Shanghai.

May 5, 1927.

REPORT ON Communist activities connected with Java

Made by D. I. Yorke Forwarded by [签名]

Sir,
I beg to report that, at 5 p.m. on April 30, acting
on instructions, I called upon Mr. Bos, Vice-Consul for the
Netherlands at the Consulate-General, No.64 Route Gisi.
Mr. Bos furnished the following names as those of Communists
operating in Shanghai in connection with activities in Java.
- 1. Tam Malaka alias Tam Moy Chan (陳麼昌)
- 2. Soedira
- 3. Alimin
- 4. Bachtiar
- 5. Tungko, Mohamed Ali Bashia
- 6. Thio Hoe Kwan
- 7. Khe Liang
- 8. Li Eh Poon
- 9. Lheuh Semawe
- 10. Kwe Hin Tjiat (郭興傑)
- 11. Mangvendikromo
- 12. N. Kalavhisky
- 13. F. T. Donasky.
Nos. 1, 6, 7, 8, and 10 are said to be Chinese,
probably born in the Dutch East Indies.
Nos. 2, 3, 4, 5, 9, and 11 are said to be Japanese
or Malays.
Nos. 12 and 13 are alleged to be Russians.
Informating concerning these agitators was laid with
Mr. Bos by a Chinese who states that he was formerly connected
with them in communistic activities.

关于与爪哇有关的共产主义活动的报告

由 D. I. Yorke 撰写 经由 [签名] 转呈

先生：
谨此报告，根据指示，我于4月30日下午5时拜访了位于祁齐路64号总领事馆的荷兰副领事博斯 (Bos) 先生。博斯先生提供了以下名单，列为在上海活动并与爪哇事务有关的共产党人。
- 1. 谭马拉卡 (Tam Malaka)，别名 谭莫昌 (Tam Moy Chan) (陳麼昌)
- 2. 苏迪拉 (Soedira)
- 3. 阿里明 (Alimin)
- 4. 巴赫蒂亚尔 (Bachtiar)
- 5. 通科，穆罕默德·阿里·巴希亚 (Tungko, Mohamed Ali Bashia)
- 6. 张和宽 (Thio Hoe Kwan)
- 7. 谢良 (Khe Liang)
- 8. 李义潘 (Li Eh Poon)
- 9. 勒乌·塞马韦 (Lheuh Semawe)
- 10. 郭兴杰 (Kwe Hin Tjiat) (郭興傑)
- 11. 曼文迪克罗莫 (Mangvendikromo)
- 12. N. 卡拉夫斯基 (N. Kalavhisky)
- 13. F. T. 多纳斯基 (F. T. Donasky)。
据称，第1、6、7、8和10号为华人，可能出生于荷属东印度。
据称，第2、3、4、5、9和11号为日本人或马来人。
据称，第12和13号为俄国人。
关于这些煽动者的信息由一名华人向博斯先生提供，该人声称他以前曾与他们一起从事共产主义活动。

192
REPORT ON
Made by Forwarded by
-2-
No.10 Kwe Hin Tjiat is known personally to C.D.C.136
Fu Faung Liu (傅方流).
Kwe is 27 years of age, and was born in Sourabaya. He was
editor of the "Sin Po" newspaper in Asemka, Batavia, a daily
edition with pronounced radical views.
Kwe is now living at No.109 Scott Road together with Cen Kheng
Hian ( ) the person whose nationality was in dispute
in the Provisional Court (Central Station) respecting a criminal
case in Batavia involving Guilders 1,110,000. Kwe also
occasionally sleeps at No.49 Rue Brenier de Montmorand, the
home of one Kau Wan Liang ( ), a Penang-born Chinese working
as an accountant in the Star Garage.
According to information obtained by the Vice-Consul
for the Netherlands, these Communists reside in the upstairs rooms
of the Hai Phong Film Co. ( ), No.221 Paoshan Road. A
meeting was scheduled to be held on these premises at 2 p.m.
May 4.
C.D.C.136 visited the premises on a pretence of purchasing films
but saw no signs of an assembly.
There was, however, a meeting of nine persons, apparently
Chinese, held in No.217 Paoshan Road, which address is the
office of the 14th Branch of the 1st Section of the Shanghai
Special District Kuomintang Party.
Whilst observing this meeting, C.D.C.136 aroused the
suspicion of the people gathered therein and was himself
followed for a short distance.

报告关于
由 撰写 经由 转呈
-2-
第10号 郭兴杰 (Kwe Hin Tjiat) 为刑事侦缉队第136号警员傅方流 (Fu Faung Liu) (傅方流) 所熟识。
郭现年27岁，出生于泗水 (Sourabaya)。他曾任巴达维亚 (Batavia) 阿辛卡 (Asemka) 《新报》("Sin Po") 的编辑，该报为日报，持鲜明的激进观点。
郭目前与岑庆贤 (Cen Kheng Hian) ( ) 同住于斯科特路109号，岑的国籍在临时法院（中央捕房）审理一起涉及111万盾的巴达维亚刑事案件时曾发生争议。郭也偶尔宿于白利南路49号，那是高万良 (Kau Wan Liang) ( ) 的住所，高为槟城出生的华人，在星汽车行 (Star Garage) 担任会计。
根据荷兰副领事获得的情报，这些共产党人居住在宝山路221号海丰电影公司 (Hai Phong Film Co.) ( ) 的楼上房间。定于5月4日下午2时在该址举行会议。
刑事侦缉队第136号警员假借购买影片之名前往该址查看，但未发现任何集会迹象。
然而，在宝山路217号确实有九人开会，看似均为华人，该地址是国民党上海特别区第一区分部第十四支部的办事处。
在观察此次会议期间，刑事侦缉队第136号警员引起了在场人员的怀疑，并被短距离跟踪。

May 5, 192 7.
REPORT ON
Made by Forwarded by
-3-
There still exists a doubt about this meetin as C.D.C. 136 is of
the opinion that the persons present had all the appearances of
native-born Chinese, whereas the information obtained by Mr. Bos
is that the majority present were Java-born Chinese.
Photographs of Tam Malaka, Alimin, and Kwe Hin Tjiat are on file
in the Intelligence Office together with those of four other
prominent Javanese Communists named Moesa, Semaoen, Darsoma
and Soebakat.
A plan of the Communist organization in the Dutch East Indies
showing the names of leaders and the various districts was
furnished by Mr. Bos and photographed. Several copies were
returned with the original to Mr. Bos and the photographic
plate is filed in the Finger Print Office.
A letter in code dated April 3, 1927, from Moscow addressed to
Tam Malaka has also been photographed and the plate filed in
the Finger Print Office.
In view,,however, of the lack of facilities, Mr. Bos
requests that no further enquiries be made at present by C.D.C.
136 and no information be passed to the Chinese Military
Authorities, regarding these alleged Communists. Mr. Bos will
continue to keep in touch with his informer, and, if necessary,
call upon the S.M.P. for any assistance required in the future.
I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
D. C. I. D. I.

1927年5月5日。
报告关于
由 撰写 经由 转呈
-3-
对于这次会议仍存疑点，因为刑事侦缉队第136号警员认为，在场人员均具有土生华人的外貌特征，而博斯先生获得的情报则显示，在场多数人为爪哇出生的华人。
谭马拉卡 (Tam Malaka)、阿里明 (Alimin) 和郭兴杰 (Kwe Hin Tjiat) 的照片，连同另外四名著名的爪哇共产党人——慕萨 (Moesa)、塞马恩 (Semaoen)、达尔索马 (Darsoma) 和苏巴卡特 (Soebakat) 的照片，均存档于情报科。
博斯先生提供了一份荷属东印度共产主义组织架构图，显示了领导人姓名及各地区分布，并已拍照留存。数份复印件连同原件已归还博斯先生，照相底片存于指纹室。
一封日期为1927年4月3日、从莫斯科寄给谭马拉卡的密码信件也已拍照，底片存于指纹室。
然而，鉴于设施不足，博斯先生请求目前不要再由刑事侦缉队第136号警员对这些所谓的共产党人进行进一步调查，也不要将任何信息传递给中国军事当局。博斯先生将继续与其线人保持联系，如有必要，将来会向上海公共租界工部局警务处寻求所需的任何协助。
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
D. C. I. D. I.
